<style>
/* NEW badge — works on desktop & mobile nav */
.header__primary-nav-item > summary[data-new-badge]::after,
.header__primary-nav-item > a[data-new-badge]::after,
.mobile-menu__nav-item[data-new-badge] > a::after,
.mobile-menu__nav-item[data-new-badge] > summary::after,
[data-new-badge]::after {
  content: attr(data-new-badge);
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d4423a 0%, #b32820 100%);
  padding: 3px 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-left: 6px;
  vertical-align: top;
  position: relative;
  top: -6px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(212, 66, 58, 0.35);
  animation: badgePulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Mobile menu — badge sits inline, no top offset (links are bigger blocks) */
@media screen and (max-width: 999px) {
  .mobile-menu [data-new-badge]::after,
  .drawer [data-new-badge]::after,
  .menu-drawer [data-new-badge]::after {
    top: 0;
    margin-left: 8px;
    font-size: 10px;
    padding: 3px 7px;
    vertical-align: middle;
  }
}

@keyframes badgePulse {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: scale(1);
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(212, 66, 58, 0.35);
  }
  50% {
    transform: scale(1.08);
    box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(212, 66, 58, 0.6);
  }
}
</style>

<script>
(function() {
  const NAV_BADGES = {
    "New Arrival": "NEW",
    "Sale": "HOT",
    "Best Seller": "TOP"
  };

  function applyBadges() {
    Object.keys(NAV_BADGES).forEach(function(title) {
      // Desktop nav
      document.querySelectorAll('.header__primary-nav-item[data-title="' + title + '"]').forEach(function(item) {
        const target = item.querySelector('summary') || item.querySelector('a');
        if (target && !target.hasAttribute('data-new-badge')) {
          target.setAttribute('data-new-badge', NAV_BADGES[title]);
        }
      });

      // Mobile nav — covers common selectors across themes
      const mobileSelectors = [
        '.mobile-menu__nav-item[data-title="' + title + '"]',
        '.menu-drawer__menu-item[data-title="' + title + '"]',
        '.drawer__menu-item[data-title="' + title + '"]'
      ];
      mobileSelectors.forEach(function(sel) {
        document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(function(item) {
          const target = item.querySelector('summary') || item.querySelector('a') || item;
          if (target && !target.hasAttribute('data-new-badge')) {
            target.setAttribute('data-new-badge', NAV_BADGES[title]);
          }
        });
      });

      // Fallback — match any link by visible text
      document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu a, .menu-drawer a, .drawer a, [class*="mobile"] a, [class*="drawer"] a').forEach(function(link) {
        if (link.textContent.trim() === title && !link.hasAttribute('data-new-badge')) {
          link.setAttribute('data-new-badge', NAV_BADGES[title]);
        }
      });
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', applyBadges);
  } else {
    applyBadges();
  }

  // Re-apply when mobile drawer opens (lazy-rendered menus)
  document.addEventListener('click', function() {
    setTimeout(applyBadges, 100);
  });
})();
</script>
